cards.text: Now it's time to organize the priests. These are the descendants of Aaron, Moses' brother (Exodus 6:20). Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
Then the family gets smaller. Nadab and Abihu died before their father did.

cards.question: Aaron's sons Nadab and Abihu died before their father. They left sons behind to carry on as priests.

cards.text: So Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests. King David divides up their families, with help from Zadok, a descendant of Eleazar, and Ahimelech, a descendant of Ithamar.

cards.question: David, Zadok and Ahimelech split Aaron's descendants into groups. What do they split them by?

cards.text: Then they count the family leaders on each side, and it does NOT come out even. Eleazar's side has more. Friend, that's not a split. That's a blowout.

cards.question: Eleazar's line has ___ heads of families, and Ithamar's line has ___.

cards.text: Twenty-four families, and somebody's gotta go first. Listen, I've got ONE oven and I still stand there five minutes deciding which batch goes in first.

cards.question: How do they decide the order for the families of Eleazar and Ithamar?

answers.text: By letting the oldest go first

cards.question: Eleazar's side is twice as big, but both sides go into the same drawing of lots. Why?

answers.text: Both sides had officers of the sanctuary
Ithamar's side asked to be included
The king wanted to honor Ithamar

cards.text: Shemaiah son of Nethanel, a Levite, is the scribe, and he writes every name down. Every name. Spelled right. No pressure, Shemaiah. NO pressure.

cards.question: Shemaiah the scribe records the priests' names in front of the ___ and the officers.
As Shemaiah records the names, all of Eleazar's families are taken first, and then all of Ithamar's.

cards.text: Then the lots fall, one family at a time, all the way down the line. The first lot falls to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah, and it runs clear to Maaziah at twenty-fourth. Keep an eye on number eight, Abijah, because in Luke 1:5 a priest named Zechariah belongs to the priestly division of Abijah.

cards.question: The twenty-four lots set each priestly family's turn for ___ when they entered the house of the LORD.
This order follows regulations from Aaron, the priests' forefather. Aaron came up with those regulations on his own.

cards.text: Grab your apron, friend, because the rest of Levi's descendants brought a list too. It runs family by family through the lines of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, Uzziel and Merari, including Mahli's son Eleazar, who had no sons.

cards.question: These other Levite families stand before King David, Zadok and Ahimelech too. What do they do there?

answers.text: They cast lots like the priests
They take a vote among themselves
They let the scribe pick for them

cards.question: When the Levite families cast lots, the family heads got to go ahead of their younger brothers.
